summary: Under fakeroot the default ~/.ansible/tmp may not expand correctly and modules fail; set remote_tmp to a path that expands, such as $HOME/.ansible/tmp.
questions: Ansible modules fail under fakeroot, how do I fix it?

answer_card.title: Fix module failures under fakeroot
answer_card.answer_md:
fakeroot isn't a full POSIX environment and may not expand `~/.ansible/tmp`. Set `remote_tmp` to a path the shell expands correctly:

```ini
[defaults]
remote_tmp = $HOME/.ansible/tmp
```

or per host: `host1 ansible_remote_tmp=$HOME/.ansible/tmp`.
